author: bielunele
caption: cold relief shower steamers 🌿 ingredients: — baking soda 1 cup  — citric acid ½ cup  — corn starch ½ cup  — pine essential oil 15 drops  — eucalyptus essential oil 20 drops  — thyme essential oil 10 drops  — witch hazel in a spray bottle how to make it: Combine baking soda, citric acid and corn starch in a bowl and mix well Add pine, eucalyptus and thyme essential oils and mix quickly Spray witch hazel lightly over the mixture one spray at a time, mixing between each spray. Continue spraying and mixing until the mixture holds together when pressed in your hand but is not wet Press firmly into moulds, silicone moulds work best Leave to dry at room temperature for at least 24 hours before unmoulding Store in an airtight container away from moisture shelf life: up to 6 months in an airtight container
